items.name: A Dart for Every Man
items.acquisition: This Unique disruptor has a small inscription beneath the barrel, beside the makers mark. It reads 'In honor of the Faufreluches — a dart for every man and for every man a dart.' No matter how often the schematics are modified, this inscription is always fabricated on the weapon. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in Deep Desert, and can be found on The Exchange. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.

items.name: Abulurd's Rapture
items.acquisition: This Unique disruptor has been modified to spray doubleshots of heavy darts at a slower rate. The name is based on a popular joke that made the rounds on Arrakis a few years ago - a comment on the Baron's preferences and the virility of his younger brother, Abulurd. Anybody who was heard making the joke in Harkonnen territory was hanged, of course. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in Testing Station 142 with a drop chance of [CHANCE]% and can be found on The Exchange. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.

The schematic can be found in Shaitan's Grotto.

items.name: Adaptive Holtzman Shield
items.acquisition: A Unique personal shielding device that can be manually toggled on and off to deflect incoming darts and blades at the cost of power from a Power Pack. However, the slow blade penetrates the shield and melee combatants will take advantage of this. The shield also prevents objects from exiting, thus it will automatically deactivate when firing darts or throwing objects. It will then automatically reactivate according to its refresh time. While active, the shield generates sounds and vibrations that drive sandworms mad. Usage on open sands is not recommended. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in [LOCATION] with a drop chance of [CHANCE]% and can be found on The Exchange. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.

items.acquisition: An increased capacity makes this Unique Drillshot the anti-shield weapon of choice. An added charge mechanism was added to the base FK7, powering up devastating 2-round bursts of burrow darts. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in Edge of Acheron with a drop chance of [CHANCE]% and can be found on The Exchange. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.

items.name: Adept Dirk
items.description: The Harkonnen Dirk is a short dagger used for self-defense. Can penetrate shields. A Great House item.

items.name: Adept Disruptor M11
items.description: As the Holtzman Effect is impervious to fast moving ballistics, Disruptors instead fire darts of variable velocities in order to find penetration points on the shield. Once inside a Holtzman Shield they trigger a static pulse that impacts the power flow to the shield. If enough disruptor darts penetrate, a shield can be taken offline. A Great House item.

items.name: Adept Disruptor Pistol
items.location: Wreck of the Archidamas III, Wreck of the Proxenus and Wreck of the Stasanor
items.acquisition: This Unique heavy pistol borrows technology from the fast-firing disruptor submachine gun, while adding a charging mechanism to fire shield-destabilizing darts. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in Wreck of the Archidamas III, Wreck of the Proxenus and Wreck of the Stasanor with a drop chance of 14.286% and can be found on The Exchange. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.
items.description: This Unique heavy pistol borrows technology from the fast-firing disruptor submachine gun, while adding a charging mechanism to fire shield-destabilizing darts.

items.name: Adept Drillshot FK7
items.description: Double barrel mid range shotgun that fires "burrow darts". When colliding with an active shield, burrow darts stick to them and penetrate them after a short time, dealing damage to the protected target.

items.name: Adept GRDA 44
items.description: Heavy for its size, it is highly recommended to hold the GRDA 44 with both hands, despite certain actors portraying its use with one in each hand.

items.name: Adept High-payload Rocket Module Schematic
items.description: The rockets fired by this Unique medium ornithopter rocket module have a higher payload, increasing the blast radius at the cost of fire rate.

items.name: Adept JABAL Spitdart
items.description: Another workhorse of a weapon, the JABAL Spitdart is scoped for long range engagements and fires darts capable of poisoning targets.

items.name: Adept Karpov 38
items.description: State-of-the-art assault weapon and status notifier in mercenary and other parastate military circles.

items.name: Adept Kindjal
items.description: A common personal weapon popular among the family members of this Great House, the Atreides Kindjal is styled after the particular variety that Duke Leto Atreides himself carries.

items.name: Adept Light Ornithopter Inventory
items.description: Adds inventory space to a Scout Ornithopter. Use a Welding Torch to attach it to a Scout Ornithopter Body Hull.

items.name: Adept Light Ornithopter Scanner
items.description: Adds a scan ability to the Ornithopter. Use a Welding Torch to attach it to the cockpit.

items.name: Adept Maula Pistol
items.description: Lightweight but with a short range, the Maula Pistol is a reliable sidearm.

items.name: Adept Rafiq Snubnose
items.description: There is a Rafiq Snubnose Pistol in the cabinet by the bed of Count Daran of Ishkal. His wife is unaware and would disapprove.

items.name: Adept Rapier
items.description: The Great House Atreides Rapier is a longer sword used for self-defense. Can penetrate shields. It is a long blade, with longer reach and more raw damage.

items.name: Adept Sandbike Inventory
items.description: Adds inventory space to the Sandbike. Use a Welding Torch to attach it to a Sandbike Hull.

items.name: Adept Sword
items.description: The sword is longer and heavier than a kindjal, but utilizes sweeping attacks that can help deal with multiple foes. Can penetrate shields. A Great House item.

items.name: Adept Tripleshot Repeating Rifle Schematic
items.description: This Unique non-scoped Spitdart Rifle was developed with increased magazine capacity and fires poison-coated darts in a horizontal tripleshot pattern.

items.name: Adept Vulcan GAU-92
items.description: A light machine gun that sports a large capacity magazine and a high fire rate. Used for crowd control against multiple opponents.

items.location: Wreck of the Eumenes, Wreck of the Hyperbatas, Wreck of the Cycliadas, Wreck of the Dioedas and Wreck of the Orsippus

items.name: Aluminum Welding Wire
items.description: Welding material is required when using the welding torch to repair vehicle parts. Crafted from salvaged metal parts.

Though most never knew of his treachery, this Unique kindjal became popular on Arrakis for the opposite reason, it was capable of stealing blood from enemies and storing it in the compartment. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in [LOCATION] with a drop chance of [CHANCE]% and can be found on The Exchange. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.

items.name: Fivefinger's Tripleshot Rifle
items.acquisition: This Unique non-scoped Spitdart Rifle was developed with increased magazine capacity and fires poison-coated darts in a horizontal tripleshot pattern. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in [LOCATION] with a drop chance of [CHANCE]% and can be found on The Exchange. It is also sold by the Weapons Merchant in the faction cities. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.
items.description: For many years, the nobles of House Wydras lived in constant fear of an assassin's dart fired by the infamous Fivefingers. In his youth, he lost his right hand and eye during a duel with a Wydras nobleman. He disappeared from public eye for a long time — then returned with this Unique tripleshot rifle to wreak vengeance on those who had left him maimed.

items.description: The beauty of the open desert has enchanted for millennia, but it offers little in the way of cover should one require it. Equipped with a power pack, the Holtzman provides just that.

items.name: Holtzman Shield Mk2
items.description: An Old Imperial personal shielding device that can be manually toggled on and off to deflect incoming darts and blades at the cost of power from a Power Pack. However, the slow blade penetrates the shield and melee combatants will take advantage of this. The shield also prevents objects from exiting, thus it will automatically deactivate when firing darts or throwing objects. It will then automatically reactivate according to its refresh time. While active, the shield generates sounds and vibrations that drive sandworms mad. Usage on open sands is not recommended.

items.name: House Sandbike Inventory
items.description: Adds inventory space to the Sandbike. Use a Welding Torch to attach it to a Sandbike Hull.

items.name: House Sword
items.description: The sword is longer and heavier than a kindjal, but utilizes sweeping attacks that can help deal with multiple foes. Can penetrate shields. A Great House item.

items.name: House Vulcan GAU-92
items.description: A light machine gun that sports a large capacity magazine and a high fire rate. Used for crowd control against multiple opponents.

items.name: House Welding Torch
items.description: A welding torch with above-average-quality repair capabilities in terms of durability and longevity. Welding Wire is required for repairs. It can also be used to assemble or disassemble vehicles.

items.name: HP Boost
items.description: Equip to double available hitpoints.

items.name: Hummingbird Wing Module Mk5
items.acquisition: This Unique wing was developed during the Harkonnen stewardship of Arrakis, before the current War of Assassins. The Fremen were fond of raiding Harkonnen bases and stealing these Ornithopters, then using them in kamikaze attacks on harvesting operations. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in Testing Station 148 and Testing Station 93 with a drop chance of [CHANCE]% and can be found on The Exchange. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.

items.description: A crude device for extracting blood from corpses and into a Blood Sack. Blood can be processed into water with a Blood Purifier at a base. It is rumored that the Fremen have perfected a field version of this device.

items.description: Harmless to humans, it is uniquely suited to extracting resources. This version works on granite, copper, metal, and doors. Analysis mode shows weak points. Depletes power from a Power Pack.

items.description: Lightweight but with a short range, the Maula Pistol is a reliable sidearm.

items.name: Improvised Power Pack
items.description: Essential item that allows the user to operate equipment that requires power. When all power is depleted, stop the current activity to allow the battery to recharge.

items.name: Indara's Lullaby
items.location: Testing Station 152 and Deep Desert caves in PvP sectors
items.acquisition: When the War of Assassins came to Arrakis, Indara and her husband, Ardan, were stationed at a small Atreides outpost on the Shield Wall. As the relentless attacks of the Harkonnens continued, Ardan forced Indara to flee into a nearby cave system with their young child. Nobody knows why this Unique weapon is named for Indara — but there is speculation that she and her child still haunt the caves of the Deep Desert Shield Wall. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in Testing Station 152 and Deep Desert caves in PvP sectors with a drop chance of 7%; and can be found on The Exchange. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.

items.name: Industrial Pump
items.acquisition: Industrial pumps can be found in Sentinel City chests, located in the Eastern Shield Wall. They are also often a drop from Crashed Ships and sometimes drop in the Deep Desert unique chests in Testing Stations or Shipwrecks. Can additionally be bought from Zoe and is found on the CHOAM Exchange. File:Industrial pump.png|Industrial pump
items.description: There are few uses for industrial-strength pumps on a planet as dry as Arrakis, but the Sandflies do utilize them in their operations in Sentinel City.

items.name: Inkvine Boots
items.acquisition: Inkvine was a creeping plant native to Giedi Prime, used as a material by slavers for generations. Inkvine whips were the most common - particularly for the slow burning beet colored scars that they left on their victims. This Unique light armor is dyed to look almost like inkvine, despite being made from lesser materials. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in Khdir's Shadow with a drop chance of [CHANCE]%, The Spiral with a drop chance of [CHANCE]%, Arctus Cavern with a drop chance of [CHANCE]% and can be found on The Exchange. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.

items.name: Iri's Gauntlets
items.acquisition: Iri was a leader among the Kirab who became obsessed with finding a way to nullify the Holtzman effect. His tinkering led to the development of these Unique gauntlets that use a feedback loop to decrease power usage. Iri himself claimed that the gauntlets "spoke" to him and his state of mind deteriorated greatly until he threw himself from a cliff. items.name: Kharet Viper
items.location: Wreck of the Hicetus and Wreck of the Xenophon
items.acquisition: The Kharet Viper Permit can be bought from the Arrakeen Weapons Merchant for 59,000 Solaris. This Unique sword contains a series of toxin releasing nodules along the length of the blade. When struck with enough force, these nodules release a burst of poisonous gas — capable of passing through a shield. The Maas Kharet probably borrowed this design from the slavers — filling it with a poison of their own. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in Wreck of the Hicetus and Wreck of the Xenophon with a drop chance of 14.286% and can be found on The Exchange. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.

items.acquisition: The Syndicate is a large offworld criminal organization that has never been able to get a foothold on Arrakis — due to the tireless efforts of Esmar Tuek and the smugglers to keep them out. items.name: Mendia's Boots
items.acquisition: The story of the warlord Mendia is well known among the Kirab. How she escaped slavery in the north, abandoning her former life. How she gained a reputation for brutality by executing any slavers they captured. How she defeated their former leader, Aren, in a duel and drove him into hiding in the Southern Hagga Basin. This Unique armor is modelled after her own - reinforced to keep her enemies at bay. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in Miner's Watch with a drop chance of [CHANCE]%, Testing Station 10 with a drop chance of [CHANCE]% and can be found on The Exchange. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.

items.name: Menol's Stillsuit Boots
items.description: Menol was well loved among the Kirab, known far and wide for his spice beer brewing operations. He accidentally discovered that soaking his stillsuit leathers led to a stiffer, more protective Unique garment. Like his spice beer, he shared this knowledge freely, didn't help him much when he was stabbed to death by a drunk Kirab who hallucinated he was a sandworm.

items.acquisition: Ironically, the Fremen themselves might be the origin of this knife. For moisture sealing caves, they used this Unique knife to quickly seal the plastic hoods against the cave walls. And for removal, they simply reheated the dirk and sliced the melted plastic from the walls. items.name: Old Sparky Mk1
items.acquisition: Sim found that if he crossed the wires in his power pack just so, he could create a Unique power pack that recharged quickly - but with a slightly reduced power pool. Sim's power pack became known as 'old sparky' for its constant discharge of electrical sparks - but his technique was copied widely by those who value speed over duration. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in Keyhole Rock with a drop chance of 33.3% and can be found on The Exchange. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.

items.name: Olef's Quickcutter
items.acquisition: When Olef was assigned to the great ironworks in Vermillius Gap, he didn't despair. He saw opportunity amongst the spires of stone — a lot of thirsty miners and nowhere to drink. He started stealing supplies and set up his own little after-hours establishment selling spice-laced moonshine. Before long, he was so busy he had no time to fill his mining quotas. He had a drunk engineer create this Unique cutteray to help him stay afloat. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in Testing Station 197 with a drop chance of 25% and can be found on The Exchange. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.

items.name: Pardot's Drinker
items.acquisition: Pardot Kynes first came into contact with the Fremen by killing three Harkonnen bravos who were attacking Fremen youth. Kynes lamented violence — not the act, but the loss of blood and thus, precious water, it incurred. He developed this Unique kindjal simply because if he was forced to kill others, he didn't want it to be wasteful. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in Wreck of Ourea with a drop chance of [CHANCE]% and can be found on The Exchange. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.

items.name: Searing Shiv
items.acquisition: Once there was a slave called Fila. She was captured by slavers while very young and dragged to Arrakis to serve the Harkonnen as a slave. While she lay dreaming in a slaver camp in Jabal Eifrit, disturbed by the spice that she was ingesting from the air, she dreamed of a flaming dirk that could set her free. When she woke, this Unique dirk was in her hand. Fila slew several of her captors, burning them with the knife, before she fled south and disappeared. Though some say, she changed her name to Mendia and her story continued. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in Piter's Net with a drop chance of [CHANCE]% and can be found on The Exchange. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.

This Unique blade gives a small jolt of electrical energy to the palms when hitting an enemy — offering a small stamina boost. A far cry from the legendary weapons of the Butlerian Jihad. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in Southern Comms with a drop chance of [CHANCE]%, The Aegis with a drop chance of [CHANCE]%, Passage of Artemis with a drop chance of [CHANCE]%, The Beast's Claw with a drop chance of [CHANCE]% and can be found on The Exchange. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.

items.name: Stammershot
items.location: Mysa Tarill and atop Sentinel City, it also can be found on The Exchange
items.acquisition: A young Atreides engineer with a very bad stutter was routinely ridiculed by his fellows stationed at The Aegis. To reduce his stutter, he began using semuta to help calm his mind. He became an addict, hopelessly enthralled to his semuta supplier — a Harkonnen agent. This specially modified Unique rifle was the last thing many heard at The Aegis when the young man turned it upon his once-comrades and then himself. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in Mysa Tarill and atop Sentinel City, it also can be found on The Exchange. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.

items.name: Standard Disruptor M11
items.description: As the Holtzman Effect is impervious to fast moving ballistics, Disruptors instead fire darts of variable velocities in order to find penetration points on the shield. Once inside a Holtzman Shield they trigger a static pulse that impacts the power flow to the shield. If enough disruptor darts penetrate, a shield can be taken offline. A Great House item.

items.name: Standard Filter
items.description: A CHOAM-patented filter with improved protection against the harsh winds of Arakkis. Needed to keep Windtraps running and clear of sand. Fitted for smaller Windtraps. Can be crafted in a Survival Fabricator.

items.name: Standard GRDA 44
items.description: Heavy for its size, it is highly recommended to hold the GRDA 44 with both hands, despite certain actors portraying its use with one in each hand. A Great House item.

items.name: Standard Karpov 38
items.description: Anton Karpov continued to make incremental improvements on what is widely considered a perfect design.

items.name: Standard Kindjal
items.description: A common personal weapon popular among the family members of this Great House, the Atreides Kindjal is styled after the particular variety that Duke Leto Atreides himself carries.

items.name: Standard Maula Pistol
items.description: Redesigned from the ground up, the MK ll is a must-have for successful underworld kingpins. Or so they are reputed to be. They've not been convicted of anything.

items.name: Standard Sword
items.description: The sword is longer and heavier than a kindjal, but utilizes sweeping attacks that can help deal with multiple foes. Can penetrate shields. A Great House item.

items.name: Starburst
items.acquisition: This Unique scattergun was first discovered aboard the wreck of the Euporia in the Sheol. The crew and weapons on board were Ixian, leading to speculation that the weapon was sidestepping the prohibitions of the Butlerian Jihad. However when the weapon was opened up, it was a disappointingly standard application of heat transference principles. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in [LOCATION] with a drop chance of [CHANCE]% and can be found on The Exchange. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.

Like the station, these jackets have mostly been long since abandoned. items.name: Syndicate Boots
items.acquisition: The Syndicate is a large offworld criminal organization that has never been able to get a foothold on Arrakis — due to the tireless efforts of Esmar Tuek and the smugglers to keep them out. Nobody knows why their mercenaries have begun to arrive in the Hagga Basin, nor what their interest is in the radiated wrecks of the Sheol. This Unique armor is designed to keep environmental hazards at bay. Schematic Obtainment The schematic is found in Edge of Acheron with a drop chance of [CHANCE]% and can be found on The Exchange. The item then needs to be crafted to be used.

items.description: Strike with superior force where the enemy is weak. Refuse to be pinned down by the enemy, always maintain a clear route of retreat. A fair fight only benefits your opponent. If you expend lives to hold territory, you will only lose both. Be like water — hard to find and quick to disappear.

items.description: "The blade of the Mahdi is slow, but immutable. Like a doctor's knife, it cuts to heal. What his blade takes from you: Rejoice, for he has relieved you of a burden."

items.name: The Man in the Shadows
items.description: House Harkonnen has identified the culprit behind the theft of several decagrams of Spice. Posing as a potential buyer, I have been in contact with the thief and duped them into a rendezvous — your team is to meet them there, kill them, and bring back the stolen goods. Remember that I am paying extra for your discretion. Under NO CIRCUMSTANCES are you to bother any other representatives of House Harkonnen pertaining to this matter.

items.name: The Red Scorpion
items.description: You ask 'who is the Red Scorpion?' But I say, don't ask 'who,' but 'what.' The Red Scorpion is an idea. A stinger in the flesh of the Atreides. A poison in the blood of the Harkonnen. I am not a Duke or a Baron. I am just a man. But I am the Red Scorpion.

items.name: The Tapper
